description: Get historical OHLCV price candles for a stock at daily, weekly or monthly resolution, for a period shorthand (1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, 5Y or the full history) or an explicit from/to UNIX timestamp window. The default is one year of daily candles.

from.description: Start as a UNIX timestamp in SECONDS (overrides period). With from and no to, the window runs to now. from must be before to.

period.description: Lookback period shorthand (default: "1Y"). Ignored if from/to are provided.

ticker.description: Company identifier: the current ticker (e.g. "AAPL"), a former ticker of a renamed or delisted company (e.g. "MIGI", now BGDE), or a numeric SEC CIK (e.g. "320193" or "0000320193"). A former ticker or a CIK is answered with a `resolvedFrom` block naming the current symbol.

to.description: End as a UNIX timestamp in SECONDS. Used only together with from (to alone is ignored and period applies). At most 5,000 candles are returned per call; a longer window keeps the most recent 5,000.

name: get_historical_prices
title: Get Historical Stock Prices
